description: Pure CSS gradient background in the Silk Blend style, made with the 21st.dev Gradient Builder. 4-color palette (#1B1035, #4A3A8C, #B58AC9, #F5D6E6). Features: soft blur finish, film grain. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and page backgrounds.
